review: independent read-only review: OK. Dropping the model-branch write is exact (the guard requires the four bytes defined and equal); a kept result is returned only for an equal source and value, so it equals a fresh write; keying by token cannot collide (every hit is checked by contents); error points unchanged; callers only read the record; the lock runs no caller code. Nit fixed: the Derived comment now describes the resource memo. Notes: the memo can keep a stale source until the next miss (memory only), and a later in-place write of the state's own buffer costs one extra copy.
